HumanReview.Rationale: Identical to the phenomenon characterised in the root-cause pack: 116 pixels, same bounding area, deltas of -1/-2 only, pure grey, ink support unchanged, button chrome byte-identical. The capture path requires three consecutive byte-identical PrintWindow frames 250 ms apart, so the accepted frame is a stable rendered state rather than a mid-animation frame. Observed rate 1 in 10 runs here, consistent with the measured ~12% historical rate. Without the bounded predicate this run would have failed the gate and blocked the promotion of an output the maintainer had already approved.

BudgetUsage.Note: Well inside both per-run budgets; no budget was extended and no bound was changed for this run.
